purpose: Validate Euclidean source-detector geometry under a controlled displacement. This fixture does not model optical transmission, phase, coupling, photon statistics, or quantum state evolution.

perturbation.interpretation: geometric displacement only; no dynamics or causal optical model is implied

analytic_oracle.derivation: Nominal delta=(0.2,0,0); perturbed delta=(0.2,0.001,0). Expected values derive from the Euclidean norm, independently of any candidate scenario evaluator.

required_checks: reject missing or mismatched coordinate-frame identifiers
reject unknown component ID in perturbation
compare computed Euclidean distances with analytic oracle within absolute_tolerance_m
prohibited_claims: optical path length for a multi-component optical system
photon loss or detector efficiency prediction

provenance.note: Floating-point correctness tolerance is not a claim about physical measurement accuracy.
